paragraphs.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
paragraphs.original: Πέτρος ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκλεκτοῖς παρεπιδήμοις διασπορᾶς Πόντου, Γαλατίας, Καππαδοκίας, Ἀσίας, καὶ Βιθυνίας,
paragraphs.translit: Petros apostolos Iēsou Christou eklektois parepidēmois diasporas Pontou, Galatias, Kappadokias, Asias, kai Bithynias,

paragraphs.text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
paragraphs.original: κατὰ πρόγνωσιν θεοῦ πατρός, ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος, εἰς ὑπακοὴν καὶ ῥαντισμὸν αἵματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη.
paragraphs.translit: kata prognōsin theou patros, en hagiasmō pneumatos, eis hypakoēn kai rhantismon haimatos Iēsou Christou· charis hymin kai eirēnē plēthyntheiē.

paragraphs.text: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
paragraphs.original: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ κατὰ τὸ πολὺ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἀναγεννήσας ἡμᾶς εἰς ἐλπίδα ζῶσαν διʼ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκ νεκρῶν,
paragraphs.translit: Eulogētos ho theos kai patēr tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou, ho kata to poly autou eleos anagennēsas hēmas eis elpida zōsan diʼ anastaseōs Iēsou Christou ek nekrōn,

paragraphs.text: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
paragraphs.original: εἰς κληρονομίαν ἄφθαρτον καὶ ἀμίαντον καὶ ἀμάραντον, τετηρημένην ἐν οὐρανοῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς
paragraphs.translit: eis klēronomian aphtharton kai amianton kai amaranton, tetērēmenēn en ouranois eis hymas

paragraphs.text: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
paragraphs.original: τοὺς ἐν δυνάμει θεοῦ φρουρουμένους διὰ πίστεως εἰς σωτηρίαν ἑτοίμην ἀποκαλυφθῆναι ἐν καιρῷ ἐσχάτῳ.
paragraphs.translit: tous en dynamei theou phrouroumenous dia pisteōs eis sōtērian hetoimēn apokalyphthēnai en kairō eschatō.

paragraphs.text: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε, ὀλίγον ἄρτι εἰ δέον λυπηθέντες ἐν ποικίλοις πειρασμοῖς,
paragraphs.translit: en hō agalliasthe, oligon arti ei deon lypēthentes en poikilois peirasmois,

paragraphs.text: that the proof of your faith, [being] more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:
paragraphs.original: ἵνα τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως πολυτιμότερον χρυσίου τοῦ ἀπολλυμένου διὰ πυρὸς δὲ δοκιμαζομένου εὑρεθῇ εἰς ἔπαινον καὶ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hina to dokimion hymōn tēs pisteōs polytimoteron chrysiou tou apollymenou dia pyros de dokimazomenou heurethē eis epainon kai doxan kai timēn en apokalypsei Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
paragraphs.original: ὃν οὐκ ἰδόντες ἀγαπᾶτε, εἰς ὃν ἄρτι μὴ ὁρῶντες πιστεύοντες δὲ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε χαρᾷ ἀνεκλαλήτῳ καὶ δεδοξασμένῃ,
paragraphs.translit: hon ouk idontes agapate, eis hon arti mē horōntes pisteuontes de agalliasthe chara aneklalētō kai dedoxasmenē,

paragraphs.text: receiving the end of your faith, [even] the salvation of [your] souls.
paragraphs.original: κομιζόμενοι τὸ τέλος τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν σωτηρίαν ψυχῶν.
paragraphs.translit: komizomenoi to telos tēs pisteōs hymōn sōtērian psychōn.

paragraphs.text: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that [should come] unto you:
paragraphs.original: Περὶ ἧς σωτηρίας ἐξεζήτησαν καὶ ἐξηραύνησαν προφῆται οἱ περὶ τῆς εἰς ὑμᾶς χάριτος προφητεύσαντες,
paragraphs.translit: Peri hēs sōtērias exezētēsan kai exēraunēsan prophētai hoi peri tēs eis hymas charitos prophēteusantes,

paragraphs.text: searching what [time] or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.
paragraphs.original: ἐραυνῶντες εἰς τίνα ἢ ποῖον καιρὸν ἐδήλου τὸ ἐν αὐτοῖς πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ προμαρτυρόμενον τὰ εἰς Χριστὸν παθήματα καὶ τὰς μετὰ ταῦτα δόξας·
paragraphs.translit: eraunōntes eis tina ē poion kairon edēlou to en autois pneuma Christou promartyromenon ta eis Christon pathēmata kai tas meta tauta doxas·

paragraphs.text: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angel desire to look into.
paragraphs.original: οἷς ἀπεκαλύφθη ὅτι οὐχ ἑαυτοῖς ὑμῖν δὲ διηκόνουν αὐτά, ἃ νῦν ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν διὰ τῶν εὐαγγελισαμένων ὑμᾶς πνεύματι ἁγίῳ ἀποσταλέντι ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ, εἰς ἃ ἐπιθυμοῦσιν ἄγγελοι παρακύψαι.
paragraphs.translit: hois apekalyphthē hoti ouch heautois hymin de diēkonoun auta, ha nyn anēngelē hymin dia tōn euangelisamenōn hymas pneumati hagiō apostalenti apʼ ouranou, eis ha epithymousin angeloi parakypsai.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
paragraphs.original: Διὸ ἀναζωσάμενοι τὰς ὀσφύας τῆς διανοίας ὑμῶν, νήφοντες τελείως, ἐλπίσατε ἐπὶ τὴν φερομένην ὑμῖν χάριν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Dio anazōsamenoi tas osphyas tēs dianoias hymōn, nēphontes teleiōs, elpisate epi tēn pheromenēn hymin charin en apokalypsei Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in [the time of] your ignorance:
paragraphs.original: ὡς τέκνα ὑπακοῆς, μὴ συσχηματιζόμενοι ταῖς πρότερον ἐν τῇ ἀγνοίᾳ ὑμῶν ἐπιθυμίαις,
paragraphs.translit: hōs tekna hypakoēs, mē syschēmatizomenoi tais proteron en tē agnoia hymōn epithymiais,

paragraphs.text: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸν καλέσαντα ὑμᾶς ἅγιον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἅγιοι ἐν πάσῃ ἀναστροφῇ γενήθητε,
paragraphs.translit: alla kata ton kalesanta hymas hagion kai autoi hagioi en pasē anastrophē genēthēte,

paragraphs.text: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.
paragraphs.original: διότι γέγραπται ὅτι Ἅγιοι ἔσεσθε, ὅτι ἐγὼ ἅγιος.
paragraphs.translit: dioti gegraptai hoti Hagioi esesthe, hoti egō hagios.

paragraphs.text: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man`s work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εἰ πατέρα ἐπικαλεῖσθε τὸν ἀπροσωπολήμπτως κρίνοντα κατὰ τὸ ἑκάστου ἔργον, ἐν φόβῳ τὸν τῆς παροικίας ὑμῶν χρόνον ἀναστράφητε·
paragraphs.translit: Kai ei patera epikaleisthe ton aprosōpolēmptōs krinonta kata to hekastou ergon, en phobō ton tēs paroikias hymōn chronon anastraphēte·

paragraphs.text: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;
paragraphs.original: εἰδότες ὅτι οὐ φθαρτοῖς, ἀργυρίῳ ἢ χρυσίῳ, ἐλυτρώθητε ἐκ τῆς ματαίας ὑμῶν ἀναστροφῆς πατροπαραδότου,
paragraphs.translit: eidotes hoti ou phthartois, argyriō ē chrysiō, elytrōthēte ek tēs mataias hymōn anastrophēs patroparadotou,

paragraphs.text: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without spot, [even the blood] of Christ:
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ τιμίῳ αἵματι ὡς ἀμνοῦ ἀμώμου καὶ ἀσπίλου Χριστοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: alla timiō haimati hōs amnou amōmou kai aspilou Christou,

paragraphs.text: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of times for your sake,
paragraphs.original: προεγνωσμένου μὲν πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, φανερωθέντος δὲ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου τῶν χρόνων διʼ ὑμᾶς
paragraphs.translit: proegnōsmenou men pro katabolēs kosmou, phanerōthentos de epʼ eschatou tōn chronōn diʼ hymas

paragraphs.text: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
paragraphs.original: τοὺς διʼ αὐτοῦ πιστοὺς εἰς θεὸν τὸν ἐγείραντα αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ δόξαν αὐτῷ δόντα, ὥστε τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐλπίδα εἶναι εἰς θεόν.
paragraphs.translit: tous diʼ autou pistous eis theon ton egeiranta auton ek nekrōn kai doxan autō donta, hōste tēn pistin hymōn kai elpida einai eis theon.

paragraphs.text: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:
paragraphs.original: Τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἡγνικότες ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ἀληθείας εἰς φιλαδελφίαν ἀνυπόκριτον ἐκ καρδίας ἀλλήλους ἀγαπήσατε ἐκτενῶς,
paragraphs.translit: Tas psychas hymōn hēgnikotes en tē hypakoē tēs alētheias eis philadelphian anypokriton ek kardias allēlous agapēsate ektenōs,

paragraphs.text: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.
paragraphs.original: ἀναγεγεννημένοι οὐκ ἐκ σπορᾶς φθαρτῆς ἀλλὰ ἀφθάρτου, διὰ λόγου ζῶντος θεοῦ καὶ μένοντος·
paragraphs.translit: anagegennēmenoi ouk ek sporas phthartēs alla aphthartou, dia logou zōntos theou kai menontos·

paragraphs.text: For, All flesh is as grass, And all the glory thereof as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower falleth:
paragraphs.original: διότι πᾶσα σὰρξ ὡς χόρτος, καὶ πᾶσα δόξα αὐτῆς ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου· ἐξηράνθη ὁ χόρτος, καὶ τὸ ἄνθος ἐξέπεσεν·
paragraphs.translit: dioti pasa sarx hōs chortos, kai pasa doxa autēs hōs anthos chortou· exēranthē ho chortos, kai to anthos exepesen·

paragraphs.text: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever. And this is the word of good tidings which was preached unto you.
paragraphs.original: τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν εἰς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: to de rhēma kyriou menei eis ton aiōna. touto de estin to rhēma to euangelisthen eis hymas.
